title: European tour and BBC television at the band's peak
summary: The tour was the most successful of its time and the BBC television appearance impressed other musicians.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And we had some very high points with that band, because during the -- at some given point we wound up doing a tour of Europe, and it was by far and away, at that point, the most successful tour we had had, and we did some British television for BBC that really upset everybody, because the band was very -- it was at a peak.
Was that the occasion when the musicians shut down from whatever they were doing, and they all ended up at this place that to hear -- the band?
Yeah, I heard about that. And it was

really an exciting time, but once again, about every time you get to the bottom of the barrel, then something would happen and they'd start another group or the group gets revived or whatever you want to call it.
Well, this group had -- once again, another incredible combination of terrific players.
